title: Roy Eldridge at Ryan's: never played with him
summary: He corrects Chilton: he only sat in with Eldridge at Ryan's.

blocks.x: I see. Then you were with Tony Parenti. Then you went to Ryan's with Roy Eldridge. You played at Ryan's during the summer of 1971. No?
You didn't play with Roy? I see.
I think it was the drummer who's there now...

Well, what we can establish is that you apparently were not playing with Roy Eldridge at Jimmy Ryan's during the summer of 1971, as John Chilton's Who's Who In Jazz asserts. Someone else was playing with Roy Eldridge, and so forth. But did you ever play with Roy Eldridge in the 1970's or even in the 1960's?

No. I used to go down there sometimes, the nights I wasn't working. He asked me to sit in and sing something, you know. He seemed to be more interested in my drumming than he was in my singing. Because he sings a little bit himself, you know. But I never worked with Roy, though. I only sat in once in a while, you know.
